title: Anthropic 的安全警告可能适得其反——政府已经终止了其最强大的人工智能
content: Anthropic 并没有掩饰自己的挫败感。该公司在一篇博客文章中写道：“我们不同意，小范围潜在越狱的发现应该成为召回部署到数亿人的商业模式的理由。”
original_title: Anthropic’s safety warnings may have just backfired — the government has pulled the plug on its most powerful AI
original_content: Anthropic isn't hiding its frustration. "We disagree that the finding of a narrow potential jailbreak should be cause for recalling a commercial model deployed to hundreds of millions of people," the company wrote in a blog post.

original_content: “The government believes it has become aware of a method of bypassing, or ‘jailbreaking’ Fable 5,” the company said in a blog post.

title: 人类撤回可能“破坏”人工智能研究人员的政策
content: 在研究人员公开反对该政策后，该公司改变了方向，因为该政策将暗中限制克劳德开发竞争性人工智能模型的能力。

original_content: The company changed course after researchers spoke out against the policy, which would have covertly limited Claude’s ability to develop competing AI models.
